description: This PHP source file defines the CacheClearCommand class within the OrangeHRM project, which provides a console command to clear different cache namespaces used by the application.

classes.name: CacheClearCommand
classes.description: A console command class that clears predefined cache namespaces and outputs success or failure messages.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command, which is 'cache:clear'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the cache clearing process for each namespace and outputs success or error messages accordingly.
